jobs.title: Outcomes-Based Care Manager
jobs.description: CentralReach is a leading provider of autism and IDD care software for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), multidisciplinary therapy, and special education. Trusted by more than 200,000 users, we enable therapy providers, educators, and employers to scale the way they deliver ABA and related therapies with innovative technology, market-leading industry expertise, and world-class customer satisfaction. The Outcomes-Based Care Manager is a customer-facing clinical expert who helps provider organizations shift from measuring care by hours delivered to measuring it by outcomes achieved. You will work directly with customer clinical and executive leaders to implement outcomes frameworks, interpret progress data, and build the evidence that supports value-based and outcomes-linked payer relationships. You will use CentralReach's platform and AI-enabled tools to make that work scalable, and you will bring what you learn from the field back to our Clinical and Product teams. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Payor Strategy and Network Development. Key Responsibilities Customer Advisory and Engagement Serve as the clinical outcomes expert for assigned customers, advising clinical directors, operations leaders, and executives on adopting outcomes-based care models Lead outcomes-focused onboarding, implementation, and optimization engagements, including discovery sessions, workshops, and recurring business reviews Assess each customer's current data practices and outcomes maturity, then build a practical roadmap to close the gaps Deliver training and best-practice guidance that helps clinical teams apply outcomes measurement in daily workflows Outcomes Measurement and Clinical Insight Apply standardized outcome measures and benchmarks across ABA and IDD service lines, adapting them to each customer's population and payer mix Review customer treatment progress trends, flag at-risk caseloads, and recommend data-informed adjustments to care approaches Help

jobs.title: Area Medical Director - Oncology
jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARY The Area Medical Director (AMD) is a senior physician leader embedded within a defined geography (Northeast, East, Central, or West) to serve as Natera 's primary MD-to-MD clinical presence across the community oncology market. This role addresses the intersection of medical affairs, field execution, and scientific credibility — driving engagement with community oncologists, KOLs, and cross-functional field teams to accelerate appropriate utilization of Natera's oncology portfolio, including Signatera and Altera. The AMD owns regional medical strategy, leads cross-functional field partnerships, and operates with high autonomy to define and execute area priorities. The AMD functions without a defined playbook, translates business strategy into field-level action, and surfaces clinical intelligence that informs both commercial execution and development priorities. This is a 50% field-based role. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES MD-Level Field Engagement ● Execute 12–18 MD-level engagements per quarter across defined geography, with at least 50% concentrated in top strategic community accounts. ● Maintain field presence of at least 4 ride days per month, prioritizing and overseeing area high-value and "platinum" accounts, including lost/down account retrieval. Responsible/accountable for oversight and coordination with these accounts with Associate AMD. ● Establish and maintain contact with the medical lead in the top 20 area accounts; engage 100% of flagged accounts within 10 business days. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (hands-on) - Alan Clinic
jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. 🤖 Who we are Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone. We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise . The Clinic is two crews building one experience: Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe. Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy. jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.
